CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content identified.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), its presentation as coordinate set, and an explicit origin/status field are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to a content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Explicitly identifies content locations for colour attributes (red, blue) at named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is given separately from the content coordinates for the same referent/time, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: The coordinate sets specify how the identified content is presented/organized at the given referent/time.
